verdict.rationale: Insomnia's spec design view offers a live preview of OpenAPI specs and code snippet generation, which is spec documentation-adjacent, but there is no evidence of a dedicated 'publish documentation' feature (e.g., hosted docs site, shareable doc portal) as found in competitors. missing for 10: a documented publish/export-to-hosted-docs workflow, evidence of generating standalone API reference documentation (vs. just spec preview/linting), and any independent confirmation of doc publishing in practice.
